scope: Selected shared foundations mapped at unit and chapter level. This is a study route, not a completed required-subheading audit or a claim of exhaustive NEET coverage. Start with focus chapters; other chapters and the original JEE quiz can contain supporting extensions.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Physics and Measurement
units.topics: SI units and dimensions; least count, significant figures and errors
units.review: Practise instrument readings with Experimental Skills; preserve the displayed round-to-even clarification.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Kinematics
units.topics: Frames and graphs; constant acceleration; vectors, relative motion, projectiles and circular motion
units.review: Practise moving frames, landing-height conditions and graph areas.
units.extra: Changing-acceleration extensions are supporting work; start with application chapters 1–5.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Laws of Motion
units.topics: Newton laws and momentum; impulse and equilibrium; friction and circular turns
units.review: Review force diagrams, friction direction, level turns and banked-road assumptions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Work, Energy and Power
units.topics: Constant/variable work; kinetic and spring energy; power; vertical circles and collisions
units.review: Practise choosing systems, one- and two-dimensional collisions, and the contact condition in a vertical circle.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Rotational Motion
units.topics: Centre of mass; torque and angular momentum; inertia and axis theorems; equilibrium and rotation
units.review: Review standard-body moments, reference axes and simultaneous force/torque balance.
units.extra: Rolling examples support the energy comparison; nonuniform-body integration is not a completion requirement.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Gravitation
units.topics: Universal gravity; g with height/depth; Kepler laws; potential, escape and satellites
units.review: Practise orbit/escape energy and the assumptions behind depth and height models.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Properties of Solids and Liquids
units.topics: Elasticity and moduli; pressure and buoyancy; viscosity and fluid flow; surface tension; thermal expansion, calorimetry and heat transfer
units.review: Review every prescribed modulus, Bernoulli assumptions, capillary signs and thermal measurement units.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Thermodynamics
units.topics: Thermal equilibrium and zeroth law; heat/work/internal energy; first and second laws; reversible and irreversible processes
units.review: Compare sign conventions and process paths; review zeroth-law/thermal-equilibrium statements explicitly.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Kinetic Theory of Gases
units.topics: Ideal gas model and pressure; RMS speed; degrees of freedom and equipartition; heat capacities and mean free path
units.review: Review mean-free-path factors, temperature scales and model limits.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Oscillations and Waves
units.topics: SHM and phase; springs and pendulum; travelling/standing waves; strings, pipes and beats
units.review: Practise phase versus displacement, boundary conditions, harmonics and pendulum derivation.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Electrostatics
units.topics: Coulomb superposition; fields/dipoles/flux and Gauss law; potential and energy; conductors, capacitance and dielectrics
units.review: Review each prescribed Gauss geometry, dipole orientation and isolated-versus-connected capacitor conditions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Current Electricity
units.topics: Drift and Ohm law; resistivity/temperature/power; resistor and cell combinations; Kirchhoff laws and bridges
units.review: Practise current signs, source loading, bridge balance and consistent circuit models.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
units.topics: Biot–Savart/Ampere fields; particle/wire forces; loop torque; galvanometers; magnetic dipoles and materials
units.review: Review field directions, meter conversions and temperature/material comparisons.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents
units.topics: Flux and Faraday–Lenz law; motional emf and inductance; RMS/reactance/phase; LCR, power, generators and transformers
units.review: Practise flux signs, phase conventions, resonance and transformer assumptions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Electromagnetic Waves
units.topics: Displacement current; transverse electromagnetic waves; spectrum and applications
units.review: Review spectrum ordering and uses.
units.extra: Radiation-pressure/intensity applications are supporting extensions rather than extra prescribed NEET headings.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Optics
units.topics: Mirrors and spherical refraction; lenses and prism; instruments including reflecting telescopes; Huygens/interference/diffraction/polarization
units.review: Practise sign conventions, Huygens constructions, central-maximum width and instrument adjustments.
units.extra: Separated-lens, virtual-object and missing-order applications are optional extensions; start with the foundation classes.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation
units.topics: Photoelectric observations and Einstein equation; photon model; de Broglie matter waves
units.review: Review Hertz/Lenard observations, threshold/stopping graphs and wavelength assumptions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Atoms and Nuclei
units.topics: Rutherford scattering and Bohr spectrum; nuclear size/composition/masses; mass–energy, binding, fission and fusion
units.review: Practise atomic-versus-nuclear mass accounting and binding-energy comparisons.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Electronic Devices
units.topics: Semiconductors and diode curves/rectification; LED, photodiode, solar cell and Zener; logic gates
units.review: Review all five named gates, diode states and limits of ideal-device models.
units.extra: Do not add transistor/IC pinouts as required NEET content from older JEE materials.

units.subject: Physics
units.title: Experimental Skills
units.topics: Vernier/screw gauge; pendulum dissipation and moments; elasticity/fluids/calorimetry; electrical measurements; mirrors/lens/prism/slab; diode/Zener curves and component identification
units.review: Theory recordings support observations; still review labelled setups, zero/parallax corrections and authentic data. Convex-mirror and unknown-liquid companions are included explicitly.
units.extra: Concave-lens experiment and transistor/IC identification are JEE extras. NEET focus excludes lab-optics chapter 3 and lab-devices chapter 5.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry
units.topics: Matter and chemical laws; atomic/molecular masses; mole and composition; empirical/molecular formulas and stoichiometry
units.review: Review entity definitions, limiting reactants, purity and units before mixed calculations.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Atomic Structure
units.topics: Radiation/photoelectric effect; Bohr model and spectra; matter waves/uncertainty; quantum numbers/orbitals and electronic configurations
units.review: Include explicit filling-rule chapters as well as the introductory quantum model; review nodes and configuration exceptions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
units.topics: Ionic/covalent bonding; Lewis/resonance/formal charge; VSEPR/dipoles/hybridization; molecular orbitals and hydrogen bonding
units.review: Review prescribed geometries, bond-order/magnetic comparisons and the stated assumptions behind hybridization models.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Chemical Thermodynamics
units.topics: Systems/state functions and first law; heat capacities/enthalpies/Hess law; entropy/spontaneity and Gibbs–equilibrium relation
units.review: Review the full prescribed enthalpy vocabulary and consistent reaction, phase and standard-state bases.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Solutions
units.topics: Concentration measures; Raoult/ideal–nonideal solutions; colligative properties, molar mass and van’t Hoff factor
units.review: Review concentration denominators, association/dissociation and applicability of dilute-solution approximations.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Equilibrium
units.topics: Dynamic and phase equilibria; K and disturbances; acids/bases/pH, buffers/hydrolysis; solubility and common ions
units.review: Review physical equilibria, acid/base frameworks and coupled mass/charge balances alongside worked acid/base examples.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry
units.topics: Oxidation numbers and balancing; conductance/Kohlrausch; cells, potentials/Nernst, Gibbs relation; electrolysis and batteries
units.review: Review concentration conventions, ionic equations and the named battery/fuel-cell cases.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Chemical Kinetics
units.topics: Rates and rate laws; order versus molecularity; zero/first-order integrals and half-lives; Arrhenius and collision theory
units.review: Practise model-testing graphs and activation-energy calculations.
units.extra: Higher-order or detailed mechanism extensions are supporting examples; the prescribed integrated laws are zero and first order.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
units.topics: Modern periodic law and blocks; radius/ionization/electron gain/electronegativity; valence, oxidation and reactivity trends
units.review: Keep definitions and sign conventions explicit; review first-member and successive-ionization exceptions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: p-Block Elements
units.topics: Groups 13–18 electronic configurations; general physical/chemical trends across/down groups; unique first-member behavior
units.review: Start with chapters 1–8 and trend/first-member comparisons.
units.extra: Detailed individual compound preparation/reaction chapters are JEE supporting extensions, not extra NEET 2026 unit headings.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: d- and f-Block Elements
units.topics: First-row configurations and properties; oxidation/color/magnetism/catalysis/alloys; dichromate/permanganate; lanthanoids/actinoids
units.review: Include preparation and use of the two prescribed oxidants and contraction/configuration comparisons.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Coordination Compounds
units.topics: Werner/ligands/coordination number; nomenclature and isomerism; VBT/basic CFT, color/magnetism and applications
units.review: Review mononuclear naming, geometry, electron counts and qualitative CFT; distinguish model assumptions from measurements.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Purification and Characterisation of Organic Compounds
units.topics: Crystallization/sublimation/distillation/extraction/chromatography; N/S/P/halogen detection and quantitative estimates; empirical/molecular formula calculations
units.review: Include the explicit method-comparison and phosphorus-analysis chapters; review each method’s selection conditions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
units.topics: Carbon bonding and classification; nomenclature/isomerism; bond fission/intermediates; inductive/electromeric/resonance/hyperconjugation effects and reaction types
units.review: Review all four electronic effects and structural versus stereochemical distinctions; later variants need not become new requirements.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Hydrocarbons
units.topics: Alkanes/conformations/substitution; alkene/alkyne additions, oxidation and polymerization; benzene/aromatic substitution and directing effects
units.review: Review named preparation/addition pathways, peroxide limits and aromatic orientation with stated conditions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Organic Compounds Containing Halogens
units.topics: Preparation/properties and C–X bond; substitution mechanisms; uses and environmental effects of named organohalogens
units.review: Review prescribed named compounds and environmental discussion as well as mechanism questions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen
units.topics: Alcohol/phenol/ether preparation and reactions; carbonyl additions/reductions/condensations/tests; carboxylic-acid strength
units.review: Include ethers and named phenol/carbonyl reactions; further mixed functional-group cases remain.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen
units.topics: Amine preparation/classification/structure/basicity and identification; diazonium salts and synthetic importance
units.review: Review aqueous versus gas-phase basicity, amine class tests and diazonium product conditions.
units.extra: Some later worked examples extend beyond the listed NEET foundation.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Biomolecules
units.topics: Carbohydrates and constituent sugars; amino acids/protein levels/enzymes; vitamin classification/functions; DNA/RNA and general hormones
units.review: Include vitamin-function and nucleic-acid chapters. Biology Biomolecules is useful reinforcement but does not replace this Chemistry mapping.
units.extra: Detailed stereochemical counting, enzyme saturation and peptide-constraint extensions exceed the elementary headings.

units.subject: Chemistry
units.title: Principles Related to Practical Chemistry
units.topics: Element/functional-group detection; six named preparations; indicators and permanganate titrations; listed cations/anions; calorimetry, sols and iodide–peroxide kinetics
units.review: Chapters 42–51 add explicit preparation, sol, heat, clock and interference reasoning. Review observations and confirmatory evidence; a mentioned test is not proof of practical proficiency.
units.extra: Some multication separation variants are supporting work; do not enlarge the prescribed ion list by copying every JEE example.
